subject: english
title: Unit 6 Mission
subtitle: Protect the oceans — the three Think. Pair. Share. questions, said out loud.

content: Take on the unit mission: Protect the oceans.
Answer the three Think. Pair. Share. questions out loud, with a reason for each.
Explain what Dr. Sylvia Earle means by being connected to the ocean.
language: Give obligations with must and have to, and prohibitions with can't (Grammar 1).
Name one real, specific action rather than a vague one.

notes: The mission statement, the three Think. Pair. Share. questions and the Dr. Sylvia Earle quotation are verbatim from Student Book p. 104. The four reasons on slide 3 are drawn from the final paragraph of the Reading on p. 103 (food, tourism and jobs, new medicines) plus oxygen, which is in the unit vocabulary. Nothing on these slides quotes text beyond the page itself.
